n: <int> Number of items available for packing into the knapsack.
density_percent: <int> Percentage of entries in the profit matrix that are nonzero.
capacity: <int> Maximum total weight the knapsack can hold.
weights: <list[int], length n> Weight of each item.
profit_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Symmetric matrix where each diagonal entry gives the individual profit for selecting that item and each off-diagonal entry gives the additional joint profit earned when both items in the pair are selected together.
